Definition: probably of foreign origin; Patara, a place in Asia Minor:--Patara.
BiblicalUsage: Patara is a place in Asia Minor, a port on the Lycian coast. Paul lands there on his way to Jerusalem in Acts 21:1, after sailing from Cos and Rhodes, and finds a ship sailing over to Phoenicia and goes aboard.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the ports on Paul's route are part of the providence that carried him to Jerusalem, and every harbour on the way was a step in the journey God had set.
